channel.title: Parallax
channel.description: Same event, different vantage points. Geopolitical news compared across Western, Eastern, Middle Eastern and Russian outlets.

item.title: Argentina seeks international arbitration and a halt to oil exploration in the Falkland Islands.
item.description: How Western and Russian media outlets frame the same arbitration as either a legal hurdle or a territorial defiance.

item.title: Trump Rejects Iran's Hormuz Peace Proposal as Both Sides Prepare for Potential Conflict
item.description: President Donald Trump rejected a seven-day peace roadmap from Iran aimed at reopening the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for the release of frozen assets. While all sources confirm the diplomatic deadlock, coverage differs significantly in framing the consequences of the rejection. Western outlets portray the situation as a procedural hurdle in a diplomatic cycle, whereas Middle Eastern and Russian sources emphasize military readiness and the immediate threat of a potential armed conflict.
